notes.title: New party-building, roguelike game, Vivid World, Steam Store Page Now Live!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! Been a while, hasn't it?
How have you all been?
We're pleased to announce that the Steam Store page for our completely new party-building, roguelike strategy game Vivid World is now liveːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː
The director of Vivid Knight, [url=https://twitter.com/torunakamura_3][b]Tohru Nakamura[/b][/url], also directed this new game!

[previewyoutube=JFfBAsfutMk;full][/previewyoutube]

This new story takes place in the Netherworld, a land of demons.
Here you'll be able to utilize and master our protagonist, Lemuria's new Jewel Magic to conquer strange dungeons.
Plus, brand new quirky characters will join you in the Netherworld to help you create the strongest, dungeon-busting party you've ever seen!

[h3][u][b]Introducing New Gameplay Elements![/b][/u][/h3]
・Party building. You can equip the new item "Orbs" to each character in your party, which means your ability to create and change your party has now expanded infinitely!

・Battle system. Battles will advance automatically while you utilize "Gems" to support your party, and now you can even combine Gems! Perhaps these Gems are also hiding a few secret powers of their own…

・An engaging story. Just who are these characters who have transformed into Jewels? Strengthen your bonds with them and unleash their hidden powers, and you might uncover the mystery...


[h3][u][b]Official Social Media accounts for Vivid Knight will be updated![/b][/u][/h3]
[b]・The Official X account will now be named "Vivid Series"![/b]
We will post all information regarding Vivid Knight and Vivid World on our official X account.
We plan to release all the latest news including details regarding Vivid World there!

[url=https://twitter.com/Vivid_Series_EN][b]"Vivid Series" Official X[/b][/url]

[b]・Our Official YouTube will now have videos about all of Asobism's PC and console games![/b]
Make sure you check out all the latest trailers on all of Asobism's PC and console games, including the Vivid Series!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/@asobism_official][b]Asobism - PC & Console Games[/b][/url]


[h3]Be sure to follow us on social media and place Vivid World on your Wishlist![/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2468550/Vivid_World/][b]"Vivid World"Steam Store Page[/b][/url]

notes.content:
The highly praised game Vivid Knight has also started to support Russian, Spanish, and macOS (all languages).

[url=	https://www.asobism.co.jp/vividknight/video/vivid_en.mp4]View the promotional video here[/url]

"A brand new, never-before-seen genre of game."
"It looks like an easy-to-play, casual game on the surface, but it's actually really challenging and requires you to think strategically."
"It's so immersive. I get stuck into it, and then time starts flying by."
These are just some of the many positive responses players have had to Vivid Knight.
Experience this party-building roguelike adventure for yourself!


[h2]■ What is Vivid Knight?[/h2]
Join forces with knights transformed into jewels by the Black Witch and combine their abilities to build an unbeatable party in this roguelike adventure.
Explore randomly-generated dungeons and defeat the bosses lurking on the lower floors!

notes.title: It is out now! — Vivid Knight : Party-building Roguelike game
notes.content:
Asobism, the company that developed and manages the popular Japanese smartphone games “CASTLE&DRAGON" and "DRAGON POKER" has come out with their very first PC game [Vivid Knight], which has released today!

[h3]What is [Vivid Knight]?[/h3]
It is a rogue-like game, gathering the knights who had been turned into jewels by the Black Witch, [Party-building] is the key factor to fight with enemies combining each knight's skill.
Dive into the dungeon that changes with every playthrough, and defeat the boss that awaits you in its depths.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40515254/412a91ab7bb4a9f95c2b96ac3e4d6ea73c5618e2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40515254/49e0e083a2c2f88ffede8d2cb51c301408a3fb34.jpg[/img]


The characteristics of the game is contrary to its cute appearance, [Vivid Knight] offers an authentic dungeon battle experience.
Challenge yourself to the difficulties that occur one after another!


[h3]▼Partial introduction of [Vivid Knight] from game media regarding trial play！*Japanese Only[/h3]

notes.title: A party-building roguelike adventure "Vivid Knight" will launch on May 27,2021!
notes.content:
The launch of "Vivid Knight" the first PC game produced by the Japanese development company Asobism Co., Ltd., has been decided on May 27, 2021(JST).
In line with this, the Steam store page has also been open since May 12(JST).
Please wait until launch!

[[url=https://www.asobism.co.jp/vividknight/video/vivid_en.mp4]"Vivid Knight” Promotional Video[/url]

[h2]What is "Vivid Knight"?[/h2]
Join forces with knights turned into jewels by the Black Witch and combine their abilities to build an unbeatable party in this roguelike adventure.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569090/Vivid_Knight/
